content.title: Trump reportedly pardons Jensen Huang
content.caption: President Trump reportedly pardons Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

slides.heading: Trump reportedly pardons Jensen Huang
slides.text: President Trump reportedly pardons Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

slides.heading: The Scandal
slides.text: Jensen Huang was ousted from Nvidia and is facing ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence.

slides.heading: The Hearing
slides.text: Huang is scheduled to testify at a public Senate Banking Committee hearing next week.
